iconicAnchor.label: Jewelry isolated as a resplendent crafted object
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Museum jewelry display and decorative-arts object study
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Met frames jewelry through material value, design quality, craftsmanship, reflection, refraction, and the shift of attention from the wearer to the object itself.

sources.title: The Resplendent Body
supports: Jewelry display depends on material value, design quality, craftsmanship, and controlled interaction with light.
The object can become the primary focus, supporting isolation and close inspection rather than lifestyle staging.

supports: The exact bundled object source records the small precious scale, metal setting, gemstones, and museum provenance.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches luxury signal, object scale, velvet, glass, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/jewelry-vitrine/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
